name: list_messages
title: 读取聊天记录
description: Read the group chat in time order (people and bot final replies). Messages are #seq; page or jump with before / after / around. Thread replies are not in the main chat: a root shows its reply count; read them with thread.

group.description: Group id (from get_group_info); default: this conversation

thread.description: Read the thread of root message #seq instead of the main chat

author.description: Only this author (person or bot name, substring match)

name: search_messages
title: 检索聊天记录
description: Search the chat by keyword, newest first; group=all searches every group you are in.

group.description: Group id, or all = every group you can read; default: this conversation

author.description: Only this author (person or bot name, substring match)

name: get_group_info
title: 群信息与成员
description: Group name, notice, mode, repos, members (people and bots with status) and other groups you can read.

group.description: Group id (from get_group_info); default: this conversation

name: get_run
title: 查看运行记录
description: A bot run's trigger, status, summary, changed files, usage, questions and answers; include_patch adds the diff.

name: list_questions
title: 提问卡片历史
description: Past question cards and their answers: reuse decisions already made.

group.description: Group id (from get_group_info); default: this conversation

name: fetch_attachments
title: 下载历史附件
description: Download a message's attachments into .gonggong/attachments/ and return their paths.

name: list_feishu_messages
title: 读取飞书群消息
description: Read recent messages of the bound Feishu chat live, as the requester (nothing stored). Only messages to bots sync here: use it for earlier discussion in Feishu.

before.description: Messages before this time, ISO 8601 (given at the end of the previous page)

name: preview_expose
title: 发布预览
description: Publish a web page or service on a local port to members: returns a preview link and posts a preview card. Start the service with service_start first.

service.description: A service_start service; uses its port

miniprogram.description: Set by preview_miniprogram; do not use

path.description: Path to open (starts with /, may have a query), default /

name: preview_gui
title: 发布桌面应用预览
description: Stream the windows of a desktop app started with service_start (e.g. Electron, Tauri) to members through a preview card; with the bot owner's consent they can control it. Only that process's windows, never the whole screen.

service.description: A desktop app started with service_start; its windows are streamed

name: preview_close
title: 关闭预览
description: Close a preview link (the service keeps running).

name: progress_card
title: 进度卡片
description: Post a live progress card (build, deploy…); pass its id to update the same card, also in later turns (only given fields change). For long tasks polling outside state; at the end mark stages done or failed with the reason.

id.description: Card id to update (from progress_card); omit to create one

title.description: Title, e.g. 「部署 luke-server 到 test」; required to create

name.description: Stage name, e.g. 构建, 部署

stages.description: All stages with their status (replaces them); required to create

detail.description: One line, e.g. build number or failure reason; null clears

link.description: One link, e.g. build log; null clears

name: hand_off
title: 交给其他 Bot
description: Hand work to another bot: after this turn a message from you @-mentions it with the task and it starts. group hands to a bot of another group you are in. Writing @name in a reply does not start it.

bot.description: Bot to take over (a bot of the target group, see get_group_info)

task.description: The task: what to do, the context it needs, and when it is done

group.description: Group id when the bot is in another group (listed by get_group_info; you must both be in it); default: this group

name: thread_create
title: 开话题
description: Open a thread here (group or DM) for a bot to work in: posts title now as its opening message; after this turn the bot starts on task inside it. For long or parallel work kept apart from the main chat; at most 3 a turn.

title.description: The thread's opening message: what it is about

bot.description: Bot of this group to work in it (you too)

task.description: Its task: what to do, the context it needs, and when it is done

name: schedule_create
title: 创建定时任务
description: Schedule a task here: when due, a bot is @-mentioned with prompt on behalf of the turn initiator. Use it for recurring or later work instead of sleeping. Returns the next run times: report them for the user to check.

name.description: Short name of what it does

prompt.description: Full instruction sent to the bot when due; it does not see this conversation, so state the task, scope and output

cron.description: 5-field cron: min hour day month weekday (0=Sunday), in timezone; e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5 = weekdays 9:00. At least 5 minutes apart

bots.description: Candidate bots of this group, best first; the first online and idle one runs it. Default: only you

model.description: e.g. opus, sonnet; default if omitted

effort.description: e.g. low, medium, high; default if omitted

run_options.description: Model and effort per candidate, only when the user asks; give the full list when changing, [] = all default

name: schedule_list
title: 定时任务列表
description: This group's scheduled tasks: id, name, bots, timing, enabled, next run and last result.

name: schedule_update
title: 修改定时任务
description: Change a scheduled task, only the fields to change (as in schedule_create). Only tasks you created or are a candidate of.

model.description: e.g. opus, sonnet; default if omitted

effort.description: e.g. low, medium, high; default if omitted

name: schedule_delete
title: 删除定时任务
description: Delete a scheduled task. A scheduled turn may delete its own task once it is no longer needed (e.g. the awaited condition is met).

name: skill_list
title: Skill 列表
description: Team skills visible here (platform, team, group layers, disabled ones too): name, layer, description, version, in effect (lower layers override same names), editable by the initiator.

name: skill_get
title: 读取 Skill
description: Read all of a skill's files, optionally of a layer or past version.

layer.description: Layer to read; default: the one in effect here

name: skill_create
title: 新建 Skill
description: Create a team skill. A skill is a folder with SKILL.md starting with YAML frontmatter: name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, ≤64, unique in the layer) and description (≤1024: what it does and when to use it; agents load it by this). The body gives the steps, kept short; details go in references/ read on demand, scripts in scripts/. At most 5 MB and 200 files. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team; platform is read-only); applies from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team

files.description: Files: relative paths (SKILL.md, scripts/run.sh, references/api.md); binary files with encoding=base64

name: skill_update
title: 修改 Skill
description: Change a skill's files; each change is a new version, format as in skill_create. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team; platform is read-only); applies from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team

files.description: Files to add or overwrite (others are kept); renaming the SKILL.md name renames it

name: skill_delete
title: 删除 Skill
description: Delete a skill with all its versions for good; skill_toggle disables it instead. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team; platform is read-only); applies from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team

name: skill_toggle
title: 启用/停用 Skill
description: Enable or disable a skill. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team; platform is read-only); applies from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team

enabled.description: false = disable (content kept). With layer=group and no group-layer skill of that name, turns the inherited one on or off here only

name: skill_versions
title: Skill 版本历史
description: A skill's versions: number, size, editor, time; the current one marked.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team

name: skill_rollback
title: 回滚 Skill
description: Roll a skill back to a past version. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team; platform is read-only); applies from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team

version.description: Version from skill_versions; becomes current without a new version

name: kb_list
title: 知识库条目列表
description: Knowledge base entries of this group: title, id, version, tags, pinned (no body).

name: kb_get
title: 读取知识库条目
description: Read a knowledge base entry with its version.

name: kb_search
title: 检索知识库
description: Search this group's knowledge base (title, body, tags) by keyword.

query.description: Keyword matched against title, body and tags

name: kb_create
title: 新建知识库条目
description: Add a Markdown entry to the knowledge base every bot here reads: lasting facts of this group (conventions, environments, decisions, pitfalls). kb_search first and extend a related entry with kb_update instead of duplicating it. Never store secrets or passwords.

title.description: Title that says what it is about

body.description: Markdown body: the facts, not the chat that led to them

tags.description: Tags, e.g. 约定, 环境, 部署; the full list when changing

name: kb_update
title: 修改知识库条目
description: Change an entry (only the fields to change); each change is a version members can roll back. base_version is the one kb_get gave you; if someone changed it since, the call fails: read it again, merge, retry.

base_version.description: Version you read (from kb_get); fails if the entry changed since

title.description: Title that says what it is about

tags.description: Tags, e.g. 约定, 环境, 部署; the full list when changing

name: kb_delete
title: 删除知识库条目
description: Delete an entry. Needs the turn initiator to be a group admin; prefer fixing outdated content with kb_update.

name: tab_list
title: 群标签列表
description: The group's top tab bar: title, kind and target (link, knowledge entry, file, built-in).

name: tab_create
title: 添加群标签
description: Pin a link, knowledge entry or workspace file to the top tab bar for reports, docs and dashboards people return to; check tab_list first, never duplicate, never pin one-off content.

kind.description: link: a web page; knowledge: a knowledge base entry; file: a file in your workspace

knowledge_id.description: Required for knowledge: entry id (from kb_list)

title.description: Short tab name; default: the page title, entry title or file name

name: mcp_list
title: MCP 列表
description: MCP servers visible here (platform, team, group layers, disabled ones too): name, layer, transport, command or URL, in effect (lower layers override same names), editable by the initiator; secrets only as filled or not.

name: mcp_get
title: 查看 MCP
description: An MCP server's config, secrets masked.

layer.description: Layer to read; default: the one in effect here

name: mcp_create
title: 新建 MCP
description: Create an MCP server (stdio: command/args/env; http: url/headers). env / headers values may only be ${secret:NAME} (see secret_list), never plain text; when a value is missing, secret_request it instead of asking in the chat. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team/system); applies to new sessions from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team / platform: everywhere

url.description: Server URL; no secrets in it

forceNewSession.description: true = affected bots start a new session next turn so it applies at once (loses session context); default keeps sessions

name: mcp_update
title: 修改 MCP
description: Change an MCP server's config, secrets as in mcp_create. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team/system); applies to new sessions from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team / platform: everywhere

url.description: Server URL; no secrets in it

config.description: Full new config (replaces it; a new name renames it). Existing env / headers keys keep their values when given their placeholder

forceNewSession.description: true = affected bots start a new session next turn so it applies at once (loses session context); default keeps sessions

name: mcp_toggle
title: 启用/停用 MCP
description: Enable or disable an MCP server. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team/system); applies to new sessions from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team / platform: everywhere

enabled.description: false = disable (config kept). With layer=group and no group-layer MCP of that name, turns the inherited one on or off here only

forceNewSession.description: true = affected bots start a new session next turn so it applies at once (loses session context); default keeps sessions

name: mcp_delete
title: 删除 MCP
description: Delete an MCP server for good; mcp_toggle disables it instead. Needs the turn initiator to administer the layer (group/team/system); applies to new sessions from the next turn.

layer.description: group: this group (default) / team: all groups of the team / platform: everywhere

forceNewSession.description: true = affected bots start a new session next turn so it applies at once (loses session context); default keeps sessions

name: secret_list
title: 密钥列表
description: Secrets usable here: name, purpose, mode (shared / shared_overridable: shared, personal override allowed / personal), layer, filled, injected this turn. Injected ones are env vars of the same name: read $NAME; never print values or put them in files, messages or commits.

name: secret_request
title: 请求填写密钥
description: Post a 「填写密钥」 card: the initiator fills personal / overridable secrets, a layer admin shared ones; values never pass through you, the chat or logs. Returns at once; filled values are injected from the next turn. Never ask for secrets in the chat.

names.description: Secrets to fill, defined and visible here (see secret_list)

forceNewSession.description: true = affected bots start a new session next turn so it applies at once (loses session context); default keeps sessions

name: plugin_catalog
title: 插件目录
description: Creation plugins enabled here (slides, prototypes…). Without plugin: plugins, template and design system counts, whether you can use each. With plugin: its templates (id, title, group, inputs, uses a design system), design systems (id, title, category, palette) and inputs. When members ask for such work in the chat, pick a template here, then creation_propose.

plugin.description: Plugin name; omit to list the enabled plugins

name: creation_propose
title: 发起创作确认
description: Post a creation card with plugin, template, design system and inputs; a member clicking 「开始」 sends you the formal request on their behalf (or 「改参数」 / 「不用了」). Returns at once; do not start before the formal request arrives.

template.description: Template id; omit when the plugin has none

designSystem.description: Design system id, auto (picks a preset for the request) or group:<id> (imported here, see plugin_catalog); omit when the template uses none (then input-box plugins use auto, others the first)

inputs.description: Input id → value, only the template's inputs; leave unsure required ones empty and the card asks members

directions.description: Offer 2–3 visual directions to choose from first; default false

note.description: One line for members, e.g. why this template

name: artifact_checkout
title: 检出产物
description: Check out a hosted artifact of this group (design/<slug>/, the server copy wins) that this turn did not get and you need to read or change. It arrives in the workspace before the next turn, not this one; returns its dir, version and screens.

artifact.description: Artifact id, or its title in this group
